decks.ac:
* Auto-generated SPICE netlist - Flyback PFC DCM
* Auto-grounded net 3 due to GND:pin
.options rshunt=1e+12 cshunt=1e-12 reltol=0.01 abstol=1e-09 vntol=1e-05 chgtol=1e-11 gmin=1e-10
.options method=gear maxord=2 trtol=4 itl4=50
.model Dmodel D(Is=1e-11 n=1 Rs=0.01 Cjo=1e-11 Tt=1e-08 Bv=800 Ibv=1e-06)
.model sw_mod SW(vt=5 vh=0.1 ron=0.1 roff=1MEG)
* --- Transformer (parametric, series-R + core loss) ---
.subckt Xfmr P1 P2 S1 S2 params: Lm=100u Ns=3.6 K=0.99 Rwp=0.5 Rws=0.1 Rcore=1e6 Cww=0
Rwp  P1  P1a {Rwp}
Rws  S1  S1a {Rws}
Lp   P1a P2  {Lm}
Ls   S1a S2  {Lm*Ns*Ns}
K1   Lp  Ls  {K}
Rcore P1a P2 {Rcore}
Cww  P1a S1a {Cww}
.ends Xfmr

VIN VIN_src 0 DC 160
RVIN_series VIN_src n0 0.001
VCIN_SENSE n0 n_CIN_sense 0
CIN n_CIN_sense 0 1e-05
VPWM n_PWM_int 0 PULSE(0 10 0 1e-08 1e-08 3.39e-06 1e-05)
RPWM_drive n_PWM_int n4 100
SW n1 n2 n4 0 sw_mod
VR_SENSE_SENSE n2 n_R_SENSE_sense 0
R_SENSE n_R_SENSE_sense 0 0.1
VT1_SENSE_PRI n0 n_T1_p1_sense 0
VT1_SENSE_SEC 0 n_T1_s1_sense 0
XT1 n_T1_p1_sense n1 n_T1_s1_sense n5 Xfmr Lm=0.0005 Ns=0.1 K=0.9999 Rwp=0.001 Rws=0.001 Rcore=1e+09 Cww=0
VD1_SENSE n5 n_D1_sense 0
RD1_SENSE_DAMP n_D1_sense n_D1_damp 0.001
D1 n_D1_damp n6 Dmodel
VCout_SENSE n6 n_Cout_sense 0
Cout n_Cout_sense 0 0.00022 IC=12
VR_LOAD_SENSE n6 n_R_LOAD_sense 0
R_LOAD n_R_LOAD_sense 0 4.8

.end

.control
set noaskquit
set nomoremode
set numdgt=9

.endc

* Transient Requirement tr_flyback_pfc_dcm: Verify Flyback PFC operation in DCM
save all @SW[i]
tran 4e-07 0.002 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
meas tran Vout_avg avg v(n6) from=0.0016 to=0.002
print Vout_avg
let VOUT = v(n6)
wrdata time_series/tr_flyback_pfc_dcm_VOUT.csv v(n6)
let v_CIN_auto = v(n0)
wrdata time_series/V_CIN.csv v_CIN_auto
wrdata time_series/I_CIN.csv i(VCIN_SENSE)
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM.csv v(n4)
let v_SW_auto = v(n1) - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/V_SW.csv v_SW_auto
let i_SW_auto = @SW[i]
wrdata time_series/I_SW.csv i_SW_auto
let v_SW_gate_auto = v(n4)
wrdata time_series/Gate_SW.csv v_SW_gate_auto
let v_R_SENSE_auto = v(n2)
wrdata time_series/V_R_SENSE.csv v_R_SENSE_auto
wrdata time_series/I_R_SENSE.csv i(VR_SENSE_SENSE)
let v_T1_auto = v(n0) - v(n1)
wrdata time_series/V_T1.csv v_T1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_T1_pri.csv i(VT1_SENSE_PRI)
wrdata time_series/I_T1_sec.csv i(VT1_SENSE_SEC)
wrdata time_series/I_T1.csv i(VT1_SENSE_PRI)
let v_D1_auto = v(n5) - v(n6)
wrdata time_series/V_D1.csv v_D1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_D1.csv i(VD1_SENSE)
let v_Cout_auto = v(n6)
wrdata time_series/V_Cout.csv v_Cout_auto
wrdata time_series/I_Cout.csv i(VCout_SENSE)
let v_R_LOAD_auto = v(n6)
wrdata time_series/V_R_LOAD.csv v_R_LOAD_auto
wrdata time_series/I_R_LOAD.csv i(VR_LOAD_SENSE)
plot v(n6) title 'tr_flyback_pfc_dcm_VOUT'
plot v_CIN_auto title 'V_CIN'
plot i(VCIN_SENSE) title 'I_CIN'
plot v(n4) title 'Gate_PWM'
plot v_SW_auto title 'V_SW'
plot i_SW_auto title 'I_SW'
plot v_SW_gate_auto title 'Gate_SW'
plot v_R_SENSE_auto title 'V_R_SENSE'
plot i(VR_SENSE_SENSE) title 'I_R_SENSE'
plot v_T1_auto title 'V_T1'
plot i(VT1_SENSE_PRI) title 'I_T1_pri'
plot i(VT1_SENSE_SEC) title 'I_T1_sec'
plot i(VT1_SENSE_PRI) title 'I_T1'
plot v_D1_auto title 'V_D1'
plot i(VD1_SENSE) title 'I_D1'
plot v_Cout_auto title 'V_Cout'
plot i(VCout_SENSE) title 'I_Cout'
plot v_R_LOAD_auto title 'V_R_LOAD'
plot i(VR_LOAD_SENSE) title 'I_R_LOAD'
.endc
